title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 09
passage:
Typing has become the {{1}} way for students to take notes, and many of them can barely read their own handwriting. Teachers report that most essays are now {{2}} on a screen, and that a page of cursive writing looks almost {{3}} to some teenagers.

Yet handwriting may still have something to {{4}}. Researchers who compare typing with writing by hand find a small but consistent {{5}}: students who write notes by hand tend to remember more, probably because they must {{6}} information and choose what matters, rather than copy every word.

Handwriting is also {{7}} to memory in another way. The physical movement of the pen leaves a trace that the brain can later {{8}}. For young children, forming letters by hand seems to help them recognise words.

Few people {{9}} that keyboards are here to stay. The question is whether schools should {{10}} a little time each week to the old skill. Doing so is cheap, and it may give students something that a screen cannot.

blanks.explain: 选 K. standard。the standard way 意为常规方式，说明打字已成为学生记笔记的主要方式；remote 意为偏远的，不能修饰 way。
选 B. composed。compose an essay 意为撰写文章，此处用被动语态表示论文在屏幕上完成；maintain 指维护，与 essay 搭配不当。
选 M. unfamiliar。look unfamiliar to sb 意为对某人来说很陌生，与许多青少年几乎读不懂自己字迹的描述一致；familiar 意思相反。
选 H. offer。have something to offer 意为仍有可取之处，引出下文手写对记忆的好处；maintain 不能用于该固定结构。
选 A. advantage。a consistent advantage 意为持续的优势，冒号后正是这项优势的具体内容；warning 意为警告，与语境不符。
选 L. summarise。summarise information 意为概括信息，与后面 choose what matters 对应；recall 指回忆，不能体现记笔记时的处理过程。
选 F. linked。be linked to 意为与……相关联，说明手写与记忆还有另一层联系；familiar 不能与 to memory 构成此义。
选 I. recall。recall a trace 意为回忆起痕迹，说明书写动作留下的记忆线索日后可被提取；maintain 意为维持，与 trace 搭配不当。
选 D. doubt。Few people doubt that 意为很少有人怀疑，即大家普遍认可键盘不会消失；devote 后不能接 that 从句表达怀疑。
选 C. devote。devote time to sth 意为把时间用于某事，符合是否应每周留出一点时间练习书写的句意；offer 不能与 time to 构成此搭配。
